newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Q2 industrial sales up 7 pct, orders 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Danish Q2 industrial sales up 7 pct, orders 8 pct.

text.p: Danish industrial sales rose seven percent year-on-year in 1997's second quarter, with orders 8 percent higher than in the same 1996 period, the national statistics office said on Friday.

The manufacturing price index rose by three percent in the second quarter of 1997 compared with the same period a year ago, while the quantity index, indicating trends in turnover of goods and services, was five percent higher on a year-to-year basis.
